# Jeremy W. Richter

> > Personal website of Jeremy W. Richter, featuring legal analysis, law practice insights, and the Lawyerpreneur Podcast

Jeremy W. Richter is an attorney who writes about insurance law, premises liability, discovery sanctions, and legal practice management. The site includes case analysis, professional development content, and resources for attorneys seeking to improve their practice through the Lawyerpreneur Podcast and Level Up Your Law Practice initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Insurance Law
- Premises Liability
- HIPAA Privacy Rule
- Uninsured Motorist Coverage
- Discovery Sanctions
- Legal Practice Management
- Outside Counsel Relations
- In-House Counsel
- Lawyerpreneur Podcast
- Alabama Department of Insurance
- DOT Medical Examinations
- Client Service
- Law Firm Relationships
- Professional Development
- Legal Ethics

## Legal Analysis & Case Law

- [The Applicability of the HIPAA Privacy Rule to DOT Medical Examination Records](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2016/03/22/16): Analysis of HIPAA Privacy Rule application to DOT medical exam records
- [Does an Exclusion that Precludes Liability Coverage Trigger UM Coverage?](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2017/03/30/household-exclusion-um-coverage): Analysis of household exclusion impact on uninsured motorist coverage
- [What Duty Does a Church Owe to Keep Its Property Safe?](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2017/06/19/church-duty-property-safe): Legal analysis of church premises liability and duty of care obligations
- [Discovery Sanctions Can Rightly Include Dismissing a Case](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2017/04/04/discovery-sanctions-dismissal): Legal analysis of discovery sanctions and case dismissal discretion
- [A Pension Board May Be an Independent Entity from the Municipality It Serves](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2016/07/24/briefly-city-of-birmingham-v-alex-thomas): Case brief: City of Birmingham v. Alex Thomas on pension board independence

## Law Practice & Professional Development

- [How Outside Counsel Can Make Life Easier for In-House Counsel](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2018/10/30/how-outside-counsel-can-make-life-easier-for-in-house-counsel): Tips for outside counsel to improve relationships with in-house counsel
- [Mentoring, Diversity, and LinkedIn for Lawyers with Frank Ramos](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2020/04/28/mentoring-diversity-and-linkedin-for-lawyers-with-frank-ramos): Lawyerpreneur podcast episode 5 with Frank Ramos on LinkedIn & diversity
- [[Appearance] Changes to Ala. Dept. of Insurance Regs in CLM Magazine](https://www.jeremywrichter.com/2019/10/21/appearance-changes-to-ala-dept-of-insurance-regs-in-clm-magazine): CLM Magazine article on Alabama insurance regulation changes for claims
